basic_details.job_title: IIM Shillong Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Manager & Assistant Manager Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Indian Institute of Management Shillong (IIM Shillong)
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Management Shillong (IIM Shillong) has officially released the Manager (Incubation) / Assistant Manager (Admin & Accounts) Recruitment 2026 notification for 3 vacancies. Eligible candidates with a full-time postgraduate degree in Business Administration, Technology, or related disciplines, or a Bachelor's degree in any discipline, aged up to 40 years, can submit their email applications up to 24 August 2026 through the official website, https://www.iimshillong.ac.in/. Selected candidates will be appointed on a contractual basis with a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 30,000

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 40 years for all posts.

qualification.education_qualification: Postgraduate degree (full-time) in Business Administration, Technology, or related disciplines, Bachelors in any discipline
qualification.details: Manager (Incubation): Postgraduate degree (full-time) in Business Administration, Technology, or any related disciplines from a Nationally recognized institution. Minimum 5 years of overall professional experience in industry/related institutions/start-up ecosystem. Assistant Manager (Admin & Accounts): Bachelors in any discipline with proven understanding of routine administrative and accounting/reporting jobs.

salary_details.details: Manager (Incubation): ₹ 90,000 - ₹1,00,000 per month Assistant Manager (Admin & Accounts): ₹30,000 – ₹50,000 per month

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IIM Shillong Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 24-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: IIM Shillong Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available – 1 for Manager (Incubation) and 2 for Assistant Manager (Admin & Accounts).

content_sections.heading: IIM Shillong Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Manager (Incubation): Postgraduate degree (full-time) in Business Administration, Technology, or any related disciplines from a Nationally recognized institution. Minimum 5 years of overall professional experience in industry/related institutions/start-up ecosystem. Assistant Manager (Admin & Accounts): Bachelors in any discipline with proven understanding of routine administrative and accounting/reporting jobs.

content_sections.heading: IIM Shillong Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 40 years for all posts.

content_sections.heading: IIM Shillong Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Manager (Incubation): ₹ 90,000 - ₹1,00,000 per month Assistant Manager (Admin & Accounts): ₹30,000 – ₹50,000 per month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIM Shillong Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 24-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Shillong recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIM Shillong recruitment is 24th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this IIM Shillong recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the posts of Manager (Incubation) and Assistant Manager (Admin & Accounts).

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via Email.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Manager (Incubation) post?
faq.answer: For the Manager (Incubation) post, a postgraduate degree (full-time) in Business Administration, Technology, or any related disciplines is required, along with a minimum of 5 years of professional experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Assistant Manager (Admin & Accounts) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Assistant Manager (Admin & Accounts) post ranges from ₹30,000 to ₹50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Application Review and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIM Shillong located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Management Shillong is located in Shillong, Meghalaya, with the pincode 793018.
